SELECT 
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NLTR", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NMILK_AMOUNT", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NDEDUCTION", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NNET_AMOUNT", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFEED", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NADV", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH1", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH2", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFEED_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NADV_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFEED_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NADV_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH1_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH2_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH1_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH2_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NBONUS_ANAMAT", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DSTART_DATE", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DEND_DATE"
FROM
    "BGK"."MILK_BILL_HEADER" "MILK_BILL_HEADER",
    "BGK"."MILK_FORTNIGHT" "MILK_FORTNIGHT"
WHERE
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."NFORTNO" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."VYEAR_CODE"
ORDER BY
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" ASC,
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" ASC
